notes: The web page carries a small FullDev tag beside the SideCut name, and the browser tab says it too. The app on a phone keeps its plain name.

The genre rail is yours as well as ours: a + Genre tile adds any genre you type, it is remembered, and tapping it searches that genre like any other. A long press on a genre you added asks before taking it away; the ones that came with the app stay.

Recommended now asks the AI for songs across your genres - including the ones you added - and offers what it names as results, with the artist and the length, ready to add. Without a key it recommends from the rail and says so.
